Psychological board game about self-knowledge, self-development, relationships, in which there are card packs covering different areas of life. On the cards we find questions and tasks, answering them we can learn more about ourselves and each other.

This game will help you to:
- learn more about yourself
- connect more intimately with others
- find your life task
- discover new pleasures
- be more confident in yourself
- realize your desires
- take control of your life
- develop your communication skills
- gain basic insights into your life
- make your life more fulfilling, happier, and more balanced.

This is an adaptation of the Identity board game that you can purchase for a fraction of the price of the original one and you can also try it for free with a limited set of cards!

In this game:
- 290 task cards lead you through the path of self-knowledge
- 5 types of action cards make the gameplay more exciting,
- offers a meaningful activity for 2-6 people,
- can be played in Hungarian, English and German.

Why is it good to discover yourself?

To get the most out of life, it's useful knowing your talents, abilities, desires, goals, and values. The game will help you find your inner treasures through 7 types of tasks.

- The Happiness cards help you recreate your ability to experience joy and to do something just for the fun of it.
- The Creation cards can evoke the creative powers of thought and imagination. They help you formulate your desires, achieve your goals and find your life's purpose.
- The Love cards contribute to raising awareness of your relationship with others as well as their relationship with you. They also help strengthen your most important relationships.
- The Soul Power Cards strengthen your self-confidence and self-esteem.
- The Resolution cards will inspire problem solving in different areas of your life.
- The Wisdom cards can provide opportunities to learn from others.
- The Feedback cards will help you see your blind spots through the eyes of your fellow players.

This game provides guidelines for an exciting, deep conversation. When you answer the tasks that are presented to you, you will gain self-knowledge. You will also get closer to yourself as well as each other. This game is not about crowning a winner, however, if you are able to work in a spirit of trust, respect, and care, every single player will win whenever they play.

Most of the tasks are light and playful, it is a pleasure to talk about them and listen to each other. However, there are also tasks that require deeper self-examination and self-discovery. It’s not easy to go through them, talk about them, and listen to each other. But know that if you are brave and honest, you are setting an example and encouraging others to show more of themselves. 

As you solve the tasks, you will find puzzle pieces - smaller, bigger - that will slowly show a picture of your life. This game is used to put together the defining outlines of the image of your life. 

You can continue to play the game multiple times. If you do the "Advice " tasks - as an out-of-game homework - you can bring the changes from the theoretical level, from the level of intellectual understanding to the practical level, and they can become part of your life, your realizations can lead to lasting improvements to your life.

You play with your loved ones - your family, your friends - or maybe unknown people, and you notice that the game brings you closer together. Above all, however, you play with yourself and come into contact with the hidden, undiscovered parts and resources of your personality. 

Identity Psychological Board Game is a perfect entry into the world of self-knowledge and self-development. Be brave to immerse in yourself!
